nodes.label: Metal Acceleration Structures / Intersector
nodes.rationale: Kept as a selectable alternative (METALGI_RT=metal); TLAS rebuilt every 16 frames because refits degraded rays 35% over 256 frames.

nodes.label: MTLFXTemporalDenoisedScaler
nodes.rationale: Costs 4.2 ms on M1 Max, more than SVGF plus temporal scaler (~1.5 ms); may be worth it on M3+.

nodes.label: Path-Traced GI with NEE
nodes.rationale: Large error mostly missing energy beyond 2 bounces (~88% of reference brightness).

nodes.label: Shaders.metal Runtime Compile and Hot Reload
nodes.norm_label: shaders.metal runtime compile and hot reload

nodes.label: Stress Test Scene (2000 objects, 256 lights)
nodes.rationale: Small spheres use 320 triangles instead of 1280: 5-6% faster, same look; merging static objects into one mesh made rays 25% slower.

nodes.label: SVGF Denoiser (temporalKernel + atrousKernel)
nodes.rationale: SVGF's long history smears moving shadows because motion vectors move surfaces, not shadows.

nodes.label: GPU-Driven Cluster Variant (METALGI_VG_MODE=clusters)
nodes.rationale: Works but traces 2x slower than full detail: rays visit 8.6 nodes per ray instead of 3.8.

nodes.label: Flicker Metric (RMS between consecutive still frames)
nodes.norm_label: flicker metric (rms between consecutive still frames)

nodes.label: Converged Reference Images (refs/<mode>/)
nodes.rationale: Re-render and commit after any change to ground truth: scene, lights, materials or light transport.

nodes.label: Concurrent Encoder Overlap of Cascades and Denoiser
nodes.norm_label: concurrent encoder overlap of cascades and denoiser
nodes.rationale: Small dispatches on M1 leave the GPU partly idle; overlapping radiance cascades with the denoiser saves ~0.2 ms.

nodes.label: Custom Two-Level BVH Ray Tracer
nodes.rationale: On M1 Max (no RT hardware) it is 19-24% faster per frame than Metal's intersector in the stress test; one loop for both levels almost halved closest-hit cost by avoiding SIMD lanes waiting across levels.

nodes.label: Emissive Mesh Lights (meshLightsKernel)
nodes.rationale: Separate path because the shadow denoiser needs an exact unshadowed term that a mesh lacks; denoised by its own SVGF signal.

nodes.label: Pipeline Specialisation per Light-Type Set (Metal function constants)
nodes.norm_label: pipeline specialisation per light-type set (metal function constants)
nodes.rationale: No cost for unused light types: a sphere-only scene compiles to the old code and runs at the old speed.

nodes.label: Per-Frame GPU LBVH Top-Level Rebuild (Morton, bitonic sort, Karras)
nodes.norm_label: per-frame gpu lbvh top-level rebuild (morton, bitonic sort, karras)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilt from scratch each frame in 0.08-0.12 ms; a CPU SAH tree traces only 4-7% faster.

nodes.label: Light-Visibility Maps (lightMapKernel)
nodes.rationale: Lets surfels and radiance cascades shade secondary hits without shadow rays; total cost capped at about 16 maps.

nodes.label: M1/M2 Lack Ray-Tracing Hardware
nodes.rationale: Ray budget is the main cost and why the custom BVH can beat Metal's software intersector; recompare on M3+.

nodes.label: Many-Lights Sampling by Light Groups (manyLightsKernel)
nodes.rationale: Shadow rays no longer grow with light count; running it in its own kernel avoids traceKernel's register pressure (4x cheaper).

nodes.label: Quadric Simplification with Locked Group Borders
nodes.norm_label: quadric simplification with locked group borders
nodes.rationale: Locking only group borders, seam-aware sliding and relaxed UV-seam passes took the DAG from 883 root groups to one 366-triangle root.

nodes.label: Radiance Cascades GI
nodes.rationale: Default in Cornell: no temporal accumulation so barely flickers and follows moving lights; loses 10 dB in stress scene due to screen-grid probe interpolation across many small object edges.

nodes.label: ReSTIR-style Temporal Light-Pick Reuse (manyLightsReuseKernel)
nodes.rationale: Cuts still-frame flicker by a third for ~0.7 ms; visibility reuse was rejected as it darkened penumbrae (-3 dB).

nodes.label: Shadow Denoiser (visibility filtering)
nodes.rationale: Only visibility is noisy so only it is filtered; history clamp prevents moving shadows lagging. Beats SVGF on direct light (43.9 vs 30.2 dB moving).

nodes.label: Shared Light Helpers (lightUnshadowed, lightShadowTarget, lightSpecular, penumbraWidth, lightMapVisibility)
nodes.norm_label: shared light helpers (lightunshadowed, lightshadowtarget, lightspecular, penumbrawidth, lightmapvisibility)
nodes.rationale: Every kernel goes through these five helpers so many-light picking, reuse, the shadow denoiser and all GI methods work with any mix of light types.

nodes.label: Single-Loop Two-Level Traversal
nodes.rationale: Nesting BLAS loop inside TLAS loop made SIMD lanes wait on each other; merging almost halved closest-hit cost.

nodes.label: Surfel GI
nodes.rationale: Most accurate on static and contact areas; stress scene default (8 rays, 64k pool) because surfels live on surfaces.

nodes.label: Custom TAAU Upscaler (taauKernel)
nodes.rationale: ~0.5 ms cheaper than MetalFX and sharper on still images; Lanczos-3 history resampling, depth-edge motion cut and narrow dilation fixed motion. Lacks thin-feature locks so flickers 3x MetalFX in stress scene.

nodes.label: Sparse Texture Streaming
nodes.rationale: Gallery's 2.6 GB of 4K textures need 14 MB from overview; mip levels chosen from largest UV stretch with a histogram to avoid slivers requesting 4K mips.

nodes.label: Virtual Geometry (Nanite-style LOD)
nodes.rationale: Gallery's 17.9M triangles trace as a 0.4M-triangle cut in 40 MB instead of ~1.5 GB at about the same speed; one SAH tree per model over the cut beat a tree of clusters (2x slower due to overlapping cluster boxes).

nodes.label: Run-to-Run Noise Tolerance (±0.1-0.2 dB, 0.1-0.4 ms)
nodes.rationale: Treat smaller differences as noise; compare alternating A/B runs for timings.
